messages:
Jordan: FYI — CommsBridge legal pushed back on our PO; they want an explicit data residency clause and an insurer endorsement before they issue the PO. They said their procurement can't approve without it.
Anya: ugh. who's the exec sponsor on that account? can we ask them to nudge procurement?
Jordan: Sam on the partner side is looped but he's out until tomorrow. sponsor is @maria_sales. I pinged her already.
Noah: can we get a precise ask from CommsBridge? 'data residency clause' is vague — do they mean EU-only storage for telemetry?
Jordan: they attached a redline PDF in email — they want this clause: "All telemetry and logs originating from EU customers shall be stored within EU data centers and not replicated outside the EU without prior written consent."
Claire: legal here. That clause is doable but we need to evaluate operational impact + KMS scope. Also insurer endorsement: do they want a certificate of insurance naming them as additional insured?
Jordan: yes, that's the ask. Their procurement team flagged: PO won't route otherwise.
procurement-bot: PO TEMPLATE v3.4 (ID: PO-RED-34) — current workflow requires a valid insurance certificate and billing entity match for third-party vendors. See https://redwood.internal/procurement/po-templates/PO-RED-34
Noah: two blockers then: legal wording + insurance cert. Insurance could be slow (carrier lead times). do we have a standard additional-insured endorsement we can share?
Claire: we can provision a standard endorsement letter that states coverage limits and effective dates, but adding them as additional insured changes our policy stapling; need 24–48h to confirm with broker.
Anya: can we fast-track with a TRO (temporary routing override) so they can issue a LOI/PO contingent on us delivering endorsement in 72h?
Noah: finance could accept a conditional PO if legal signs off on the clause and procurement records a 72h SLA to deliver the COI. need approval from @cfo-team.
Jordan: CommsBridge said they can do an MP/PO only via their marketplace flow; they require the PO to be present in their EDI system to kick off dev onboarding.
Claire: legal pref: replace broad "not replicated" language with specific replication controls and exceptions for backup & disaster recovery, e.g.: "...not replicated outside the EU except for encrypted backup copies stored for DR within vendor-controlled regions, with notice to client."
Jordan: I'll propose that edit to them.
Anya: also flag the marketplace SKU mapping — they're insisting the invoice be against 'CommsBridge Cloud Integration SKU 9-RED' otherwise reconciliation fails. if the SKU differs our marketplace billing may reject the invoice.
procurement-bot: Marketplace invoice mapping note — ensure PO line item contains vendor SKU metadata (field: vendor_sku) or EDI ACK will reject.
Noah: can billing emit PO with vendor_sku field? engineering added vendor_sku support last quarter but finance needs the flag enabled per-account.
Jordan: @Noah can you confirm if we can flip the flag for CommsBridge? If yes we can produce a marketplace-compatible PO ASAP.
Noah: I can flip it once legal confirms wording. timeline: legal decision today, finance flip within 2 hours, insurance COI in ~24–48h.
Claire: agreed. Jordan — send the edited clause to CommsBridge with a deadline: accept by EOD tomorrow to enable the conditional PO path. I'll message broker now.
Jordan: sending now — pinging @maria_sales to escalate from their side. thanks everyone — I'll update this thread when I hear back. :thumbsup:
Anya: thx. if they stall, we'll loop in partner-ops to pause marketplace onboarding to avoid half-configured prod accounts.
Jordan: noted.
